fact: A mechanic worked on the car whilst it was serving a time penalty during a pit stop.
offence: Breach of Article 54.4 c) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video and in-car video evidence. When Car 3 stopped in the Pit Box, a mechanic at the front right was noted to have touched the car then withdrew his hand and the car then served the mandatory time penalty. However the regulations prescribes that "touching" the car is deemed to be "working on the car". Save for the touching of the car, the Stewards consider that the original time penalty was served but not correctly and this new penalty is applied in respect to that "working on the car" breach.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
team: Visa Cash App RB F1 Team
title: Infringement Car 3 Failing To Serve Time Penalty Correctly
